title: Fix default-features build of prompt-hub (argon2 OsRng)
objective: `cargo build -p prompt-hub` with DEFAULT features fails: E0432 unresolved import argon2::password_hash::rand_core::OsRng in auth.rs. Stash-confirmed PRE-EXISTING; masked because CI only builds --all-features. Fix: gate the OsRng import behind the feature that provides getrandom, or add a default-features CI job + fix root cause.
acceptance_criteria: a default-features build job exists in CI
resolution: Root Cargo.toml: password-hash dep 0.6 -> 0.5 (argon2 0.5.3 re-exports password-hash 0.5.0; the 0.6 dep never unified, so OsRng/getrandom was missing in default builds). Added ci.yml 'default-build' job building all 3 crates with default features (regression guard — every other job uses --all-features, which masked the break). Verified: cargo build -p {prompt-hub,prompthub,prompthub-server} default OK; all-features check/clippy/fmt green; auth hash tests pass.
